Name: See You In The Next Circle
PreText: [b][color=ffffff][lb]On Use][/color][/b] You may spend 2 uses of a [b][color=ffff64][lb]Limit][/color][/b] skill to activate its [b][color=64aaff][lb]Exhaust][/color][/b] effect as if it were on this skill.

Text: [b][color=64ff64][lb]Hit][/color][/b] Transfer up to 4 of an Ailment from self to target.

PostText: [b][color=ffffff][lb]After Use][/color][/b] Remove all of 1 Ailment or Debuff on self.
